subject: Air freight quote request to PVG
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to PVG (Shanghai, CN), including truck pickup from our site in 93721 (Regensburg), Germany, and transport to the departure airport?

The machine parts will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26. The shipment consists of 5 pieces with a gross weight of 540 kg and a total volume of 1.33 cbm.

Please provide your all-in price in EUR and confirm the earliest pickup and arrival times.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
